methodSteps: Review representative frames and continuous playback without Dembrandt semantic labels.
Identify visually dominant and repeated regions, not merely frequent DOM values.
Assign provisional visual roles from screenshots.
Locate the corresponding selectors, assets and computed declarations.
Keep page-local and asset-local colors out of global brand tokens.

visualSystem.stableSkeleton: High-contrast black and white navigation, oversized section titles, white content cards and black title bars.
visualSystem.stableCanvas: Paper/map-like off-white backgrounds with very light gray, cool gray or warm beige overlays.
visualSystem.stableAnchor: Deep navy bands in New Arrival and the footer provide the strongest recurring chromatic structural anchor.
visualSystem.localModules: Events uses a large red illustrated/background asset; Products uses a local blue rail; Recommend uses brown wanted-poster styling.
visualSystem.campaignLayer: Hero color is artwork-driven and changes with campaign slides; the current yellow image is not a stable system token.
visualSystem.microSemantics: Red and orange News category labels are metadata colors, not core actions.

observations.visibleObservation: The first viewport is dominated by campaign artwork and its yellow/gold field.
observations.codeMapping: Hero slide image/assets under .mvCol; navigation overlays with white/black state rules.
observations.rule: Do not promote the current slide hue to a global token.

observations.visibleObservation: News is visually governed by a pale paper/map canvas, black oversized slab title, white image cards and compact black metadata.
observations.codeMapping: .newsCol::before uses common pc/bg.webp; .newsCol::after uses rgba(211,214,224,.3); headings use Alfa Slab One; cards use white surfaces.
observations.rule: This composition and contrast system is more stable than the category colors.

observations.visibleObservation: Red has high visual weight only inside the Events pickup board; the surrounding structure remains black, white and paper gray.
observations.codeMapping: .eventsTitCol uses #000; .eventsColInner uses the image ../images/top/pc/bg_pikup-events.jpg; cards are #fff; metadata is #717171.
observations.rule: Treat red as an Events organism recipe/background asset, not global primary or core action.

observations.visibleObservation: Videos returns to the pale paper canvas, black slab heading and image-led content. A yellow border is confined to one promotional banner.
observations.codeMapping: .movieCol uses rgba(220,214,198,.3); the isolated banner border candidate is associated with footer/banner content rather than actions.
observations.rule: Do not infer a global yellow interaction system from a promotional border or campaign asset.

observations.visibleObservation: The footer is a large deep-navy structural field with white logo, navigation and legal text.
observations.codeMapping: .footerColInner resolves to #002156; New Arrival separately uses #0F1331 with white text.
observations.rule: Deep navy is a recurring structural section color, but the two page-local shades should remain distinct until cross-page verification.

rejectedDembrandtStarts.reason: Products category metadata, not visual-system accent.
Events category metadata, not visual-system accent.
Recommend module text/surface, not global primary.

nextChecks: Capture and measure representative nodes for the black/white/paper/navy system.
Trace the Events red background asset and its geometry rather than reducing it to a flat hex.
Compare all carousel slides to separate campaign artwork hues from stable UI colors.
Repeat the same recording-first procedure on News, Products and Events pages before defining cross-page tokens.
